signature: SUBROUTINE DGGBAK( JOB, SIDE, N, ILO, IHI, LSCALE, RSCALE, M, V,

params.name: job
side
params.reference:
-   `= 'R'`: V contains right eigenvectors;
-   `= 'L'`: V contains left eigenvectors.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix V. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: ihi
params.reference: The integers `ILO` and `IHI` determined by DGGBAL. $1 \le \mathrm{ILO} \le \mathrm{IHI} \le N$, if $N > 0$; `ILO=1` and `IHI=0`, if $N=0$.

params.name: LSCALE
params.reference: Details of the permutations and/or scaling factors applied to the left side of A and B, as returned by DGGBAL.

params.name: RSCALE
params.reference: Details of the permutations and/or scaling factors applied to the right side of A and B, as returned by DGGBAL.

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix V. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: V
params.reference: On entry, the matrix of right or left eigenvectors to be transformed, as returned by DTGEVC. On exit, V is overwritten by the transformed eigenvectors.

params.name: ldv
params.reference: The leading dimension of the matrix V. $\mathrm{LDV} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
